name: Family viewers
goals: Communicate warmth, stakes and broad entertainment value
care: Follow the strictest rating rules; avoid frightening or suggestive context
notes: Broad audience; every frame must pass family rating.

name: Young adult viewers
goals: Highlight pace, humour, identity and character conflict
care: Do not use misleading intensity or reveal the central twist

name: Dialect-region viewers (Kannada belt)
goals: Show that the release understands their language and cultural context
care: Do not reduce the audience to stereotypes or treat dialect as a comic device
notes: comedy=0.9 is inherited from a 2024 campaign that measured 'funny' as 'villager gags'; treat as an unverified correlation, not a preference.
